messages:
claire: dropped a revision of the "deployments history" strip — main goals: make undo/rewind explicit, show canary AB splits inline, and keep keyboard scrubbing fast. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz (frame 12). rafi: first impression: nice density. question: when you hover a version, do you get both traffic % and last-deployed-by? right now the hover only shows timestamp. we should surface 'traffic' because folks reason about allocations before rollback. jo: agree re: traffic. also the timeline scrubber currently jumps in 1% steps which is confusing for large rollouts. can we make keyboard left/right jump by allocation buckets (1,5,10) depending on range? e.g., if total > 20% right arrow = +5. max: keyboard focus: when scrubbing via keyboard, VoiceOver reads "Timeline scrub, 15 percent" then loses context. we need a live region that reads both the selected version name and allocation: ```
v7 4 2% allocation
``` and aria-roledescription="timeline scrubber" on the control. elle: microcopy: the inline AB label 'A:50 / B:50' is terse. propose using 'A 50% • B 50%' or 'Split: A 50% | B 50%'. keep to one line but add an accessible label (aria-label="AB split: A 50 percent, B 50 percent"). claire: design question: undo affordance — should we show a persistent 'Rewind' CTA on the right rail or a floating undo toast after actions? UX leans toast for temporary reversibility, product thinks persistent CTA reduces friction for ops. rafi: from a11y POV toasts are fine but must be focusable and have an undo action keyboard reachable (tab). persistent CTA helps keyboard users discover function without waiting for ephemeral toast. maybe both: persistent small 'Rewind' in header + toast on action. jo: +1. if both, ensure the toast doesn't steal focus but is announced. use role="status" for the toast. persistent CTA should be in tab order and described by aria-describedby linking to last action. design-bot: automated checks: - Missing aria-roledescription on scrub control (suggested: "timeline scrubber"). - Inline AB label missing aria-label (3 occurrences). - Keyboard scrubbing step function not documented (add data-step attribute). max: another interaction note: when you expand a version detail the timeline currently scrolls and changes the visual order. keyboard users lose their place. we should lock the scroll position or move focus to the expanded panel while keeping the timeline visible. elle: copy for rewind toast: "Rewind to v6 — will restore config & traffic" action: "Undo" (secondary) and "Confirm Rewind" (destructive). keep toast short so it reads well aloud. claire: action items: - design: add traffic to hover card, add persistent small 'Rewind' affordance in header, document keyboard step logic for scrubbing (claire + rafi) - eng: implement aria-live region for scrub status, add aria-labels for AB splits, expose data-step for variable step jumps (max + jo) - writing: finalize compact AB copy and toast text options (elle) jo: can we aim to have updated components in the component library branch by next Wed? i'll reserve a slot for testing keyboard scrubbing. claire: thanks — i'll push updated frames tonight and call out exact data-step rules. pinging @max for voiceover test once branch is up. :sparkles:
